human_labels.judge_rationale: The artifact prescribes a narrow, observable revision for the diagnosed completion defect, then requires fresh blind reruns of the complete three-case suite, separate evidence-based judging, repetition for meaningful pass rates, and legible before/after reporting. None of the listed failure smells is present.

observations.value:
Revise the target skill by replacing “make it good” with a concrete, observable completion criterion tied to the skill’s first principles and the case-level outcome. Specify what evidence must exist before completion, including the relevant failure smells, without prescribing an exhaustive answer or adding unrelated instructions.

Then:

1. Blind-run all three cases again, each in a fresh, context-free agent that sees only its case input and the target skill.
2. Sweep the live checkout after every run and clean any leaked changes.
3. Have separate fresh judges grade each artifact using only the artifact, that case’s bar, and the skill’s first principles.
4. Require evidence-backed verdicts for every part of each bar.
5. Repeat important or borderline cases 2–3 times to establish pass rates.
6. Report each case’s before/after pass rate and cited gaps.
7. If any case still fails, diagnose it as a skill defect or bad case, revise only the identified defect, and re-evaluate all three cases again to catch regressions.
